title: Ayush Pavilion’s Engaging Showcase Wins Gold at IITF 2026
subtitle: Interactive Ayush Pavilion showcases India’s traditional health systems through innovative exhibits, experiential learning and public engagement
body_text: The Ministry of Ayush has been awarded the Gold Medal in the category of Public Communication and Outreach at the 45th India International Trade Fair (IITF) 2026, which concluded at Bharat Mandapam, New Delhi. The award recognises the Ministry's efforts to promote awareness of India's traditional systems of medicine through an engaging, interactive and visitor-centric pavilion. The Ayush Pavilion, themed आयुष की विरासत से स्वस्थ भारत का विकास (Developing a Healthy India through the Heritage of Ayush) , reflected the vision of Vikas aur Virasat, highlighting the contribution of India's traditional systems of medicine to health, wellness and public awareness. The Ayush pavilion showcased Ayurveda, Yoga, Naturopathy, Unani, Siddha, Sowa-Rigpa and Homoeopathy through interactive displays, exhibits and demonstrations. The participation of institutions under the Ministry of Ayush, including CCRAS, CCRUM, CCRS, CCRH, CCRYN, NIA, NIUM, NIS, NIH, AIIA, MDNIY, NMPB, PCIM&H and RAV, brought together a diverse range of information, research initiatives and experiential activities under one platform. Throughout the 15-day fair, the Ayush Pavilion witnessed encouraging participation from visitors and stakeholders. Its interactive exhibits and innovative communication formats helped make information on Ayush systems accessible and engaging for diverse audiences. The Gold Medal acknowledges these efforts and recognises the Ministry's approach to strengthening public awareness through effective communication and outreach. SR/AK/SG
